title: crm.product.sale-products-compensated, payload v1
description: The outcome of product compensation (ADR-018 §5). Destination: crm.product.evt.sale-products-compensated.v1. SUCCEEDED takes the saga to FAILED and the order to CANCELLED — fully unwound. FAILED takes it to MANUAL_INTERVENTION, which is a state, a gauge and a log line rather than residue nobody counted: 'a partial compensation failure must remain recoverable and observable' is the whole reason this event has a failure branch at all.

failureMessageKey.description: MSG-SALE-OPERATION-MISMATCH if the ids belong to another sale — which the orchestrator treats as a defect needing an operator, not as a sale to retry.

productIds.description: The ids the command named. Empty when there was nothing to compensate.
